statement: He spent his first years with Halimah among Banu Sa'd in the desert.
Halimah spoke of blessing in her household while he was with her and asked to keep him longer after weaning.
notes: From Ibn Ishaq; the chain is discussed by the scholars. Narrated briefly, with attribution, without the individual details.

statement: Anas: Jibril came while he was playing with boys, opened his chest, removed a clot from his heart saying it was Satan's portion, washed it with Zamzam in a golden basin and restored it; the boys ran to his nurse saying he had been killed; they found him changed in colour; Anas saw the mark on his chest.
notes: Content machine-checked in the Sahih Muslim dataset on 2026-10-03; Abd al-Baqi number from memory. Direct speech follows the narration.

statement: After this Halimah feared for him and returned him to his mother.
alternatives: His age at the return is given as four or five.

statement: He lived with his mother until he was about six.
Aminah took him to Yathrib with Umm Ayman to visit his relatives of Banu Najjar; on the return she fell ill and died at al-Abwa; Umm Ayman brought him back to Makkah.
He later visited his mother's grave and wept, and those around him wept.
notes: Content machine-checked in the dataset; Abd al-Baqi number from memory. The narration continues with his words about seeking permission to ask forgiveness for her and to visit her grave; that part is not narrated. Reviewer to confirm the omission is appropriate.

statement: Abd al-Muttalib took him in and showed him special affection, seating him on his own mat by the Ka'bah.
Abd al-Muttalib died when he was eight.
alternatives: Given precisely as eight years, two months and ten days.

statement: His uncle Abu Talib, full brother of his father, took over his care; he was not wealthy and had many children; he protected him for the rest of his life.
The Qur'an: He found you an orphan and gave you shelter; He found you in need and made you self-sufficient.
notes: Verses 93:6 and 93:8 are quoted in paraphrase; 93:7 is not quoted.
